title: Odog's Gem Mod
description: A mod that adds and adjusts basic gems.
body:
# For forge 1.20.1.
## This mod adds and adjusts basic gems.
**So far we have:**
Saphires, saphire block, saphire sword and armor, emerald sword and armor, rubies, ruby sword and armor, and ruby block. No recipes for any of the items at the moment lol.
**This mod was made using mcreator.**
This mod was made for the people who wanted more gems and more stuff for the gems we do have. Amethyst to be added in a later update. This is a client and serverside required mod.
